uplink.description: Full uplink: battery, onboard temperature + humidity, outputs, digital/analog/pulse inputs, MCU temp
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds payload covering every fPort-10 channel/type the codec recognizes. battery 0x0168=360*0.01=3.6 V; temp 0x00EB=235*0.1=23.5 C; rh 0x5A=90*0.5=45 %; mcu 0x012C=300*0.1=30 C. The three input terminals become channels[] entries with zero-based labels (input0 = TEKTELIC input 1): input_1=1 -> input0 action.contactState 'closed'; input_1_count 0x04D2=1234 -> input0 pulse.count (the counter is input 1's only); input_2 0x2EE0=12000 microamps -> input1 analog.current 12 mA (upstream reports the same raw count as 0.012 A); input_3 0x0CE4=3300 mV -> input2 analog.voltage 3.3 V (unchanged from upstream's 3.3). expected.data produced by running reference/upstream-codec.js (raw decode) and normalizing per the mapping notes; the commanded output states and the MCU diagnostic stay top-level.

uplink.description: Mixed input frame: open contact with a non-zero counter, 20 mA loop current, 8.75 V analog input (per-position truth, no onboard climate field)
uplink._note: Synthetic; expected values cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js, which decodes this frame as input_1 = 0, input_2 = 0.02 (A), input_3 = 8.75 (V), input_1_count = 777. Each terminal carries a distinct value so a swapped position would fail: input_1 state byte 0 -> input0 'open' while its counter still reports 777 (an open contact does not clear the count); input_2 0x4E20 = 20000 microamps -> input1 20 mA (top of the 4-20 mA band); input_3 0x222E = 8750 mV -> input2 8.75 V.

uplink.description: Climate-only uplink: battery + onboard air temperature and humidity (no input field -> no channels)
uplink._note: Synthetic minimal climate payload. Matches the temperature/relative_humidity values the upstream decoder produces for the same bytes. The frame carries no input TLV, so the lazily-built `channels` key is omitted entirely — the common case for this device, and what satisfies the declared `climate` category from the top level.
Synthetic two's-complement check: temp 0xFFCE=-50*0.1=-5.0 C; rh 0x64=100*0.5=50 %. Upstream decoder yields temperature -5, relative_humidity 50 for these bytes.

uplink.description: TTN example: Output 1 and 2 change-state uplink
uplink._note: Input is the upstream t00056xx-codec.yaml example. Upstream emits change_output_states.output1=0, output2=1; normalized here to the extras outputState1/outputState2 (no climate keys present, so this is a supporting vector). Commanded output states are actuator state, not measured positions, so they stay top-level extras and this frame emits no `channels` key.

uplink.description: Sparse frame: temperature plus the 0-10 V terminal only -> a single channels entry, 0 V emitted (no sentinel)
uplink._note: Synthetic; reference/upstream-codec.js decodes the same frame as temperature 23.5, input_3 = 0. TEKTELIC uplinks are sparse TLV streams: only the reported terminal gets an entry (no fabricated input0/input1), and because the wire format defines no disconnected sentinel a genuine 0 V reading is emitted rather than suppressed.

uplink.description: Unsupported fPort (configuration/diagnostic port, not measurement data)
uplink._note: fPort 100 is the register read-back port in the upstream decoder, not a measurement uplink; this codec only decodes data on fPort 10.

uplink.description: Unrecognized channel/type on the data port
uplink._note: 0xAB is not a defined channel on fPort 10. Upstream reports 'Couldn't find header ...'; this codec reports an unrecognized channel/type error.
